full_judgment: 11. It is further seen that the said application though punched and placed in Civil Rule section on 13.10.90, it was affirmed before the Commissioner of Affidavit 5 days after on 18.12.90. Who are to explain all these? Surely the Government. In the result, this application for condonation of delay is rejected. The Rule is discharged and the appeal is dismissed being barred by limitation.
